cohort: The study included 700 unselected children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood 2010 birth cohort.
finding: Maternal antibiotic use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of otitis media and ventilation tube insertions in the offspring, with antibiotics late in pregnancy mainly contributing to these effects.
followup_time: At least 3 years after birth for otitis media episodes
